value.answer: This is often a stomach bug, usually viral, and most kids improve at home within a few days. Still drinking and wetting diapers is a good sign. Keep offering small, frequent sips of fluid or oral rehydration solution, and keep feeds going.
value.triage: Call 811 if vomiting lasts over 48 hours, it is no better in 3-4 days, or you see fewer wet diapers, dry mouth, no tears or sunken eyes. Under 3 months old, call 811 right away. Go to the ER or call 911 now if hard to wake, confused, vomiting blood or green, bloody stool, or severe belly pain.
